info.title: ZIP Codes by Region API Reference
info.description: Find all ZIP and postal codes for any state, province, or region worldwide. Provide a country code and either a region name or region ISO code to retrieve all codes in that administrative division; region_code takes priority when both are supplied. Results are paginated with up to 500 codes per page, and the response includes total result count, total pages, current page, and current page size. An unrecognized region returns a 404, as does requesting a page beyond the available range.

servers.description: ZIP Codes by Region API Server

get.description: Returns every ZIP/postal code within the given region, state, or province of a country.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Name of the region, state, or province associated with the country. Either region or region_code is required.

parameters.name: region_code
parameters.description: ISO code of the region, state, or province associated with the country. Either region or region_code is required. region_code takes priority if both are given.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to retrieve. Each page returns up to 500 results.

400.description: Bad Request — Missing region/region_code, invalid country code, or invalid page number

MissingRegion.summary: Neither region nor region_code was provided

BadCountry.summary: country is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.
The page number must be greater than 0.

404.description: Not Found — No codes for the region, or requested page is out of range

NotFound.summary: No codes found for the given region/country

value.message: No postal/zip codes found for the provided region Nonexistentregionxyz in country US.
The requested page exceeds the available page range.

current_page_size.description: Number of ZIP/postal codes in the current page.

codes.description: List of ZIP/postal codes for the current page.

PostalCode.description: A single ZIP or postal code.
